action.description: Bounded interaction: click, hover, focus, fill, press, scroll, or select.

delta_x.description: Horizontal delta used only for scroll.
delta_x.title: Delta X

delta_y.description: Vertical delta used only for scroll.
delta_y.title: Delta Y

element_id.description: Semantic element ID returned by the identified frontend snapshot.
element_id.title: Element Id

idempotency_key.description: Caller-generated stable unique key for this logical mutation or command. Reuse only when retrying that exact same request.
idempotency_key.title: Idempotency Key

key.description: Allowlisted key required only for press; shortcuts are forbidden.

option.description: Visible/value option required only for select.
option.title: Option

project_id.description: Opaque project ID returned by projects_list; never send a local path.
project_id.title: Project Id

purpose.description: Concise user-facing reason shown in Windows approval and local activity history.
purpose.title: Purpose

session_id.description: Frontend session ID returned by frontend_session_start.
session_id.title: Session Id

snapshot_id.description: Snapshot ID that minted element_id; stale IDs fail.
snapshot_id.title: Snapshot Id

text.description: Text required only for fill; password targets are refused by the agent.
text.title: Text
